## What this region is

The routing policy: the organizations declared in destinations.json and the projects they own, the publish switch, the per-entry write/read evidence that decides which organizations a part may name, and the rules that keep personal-only talk and Muse sessions off every organization.

## What it exists for

- Read or check the routing file
- Change who routing knows and whether it publishes
- Decide where a part goes
- Tell the server where this machine's projects live
- Work out which projects and organizations a session worked in
- Keep personal-only talk off every organization

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- cut a session into parts and check the model's plan before it routes → routing-planning
- connect a hosted Archive for an organization with a token file → destinations-and-sync
- delete the copies a destination still holds after a re-plan → destinations-and-sync
- add a collector for a new repo root in agents.json → capturing-sessions
- tag sessions with the projects they worked in so search can filter → tags-and-tagger
